verdict.rationale: The README states that Apple Silicon is a first-class citizen, optimized via ARM NEON, Accelerate and Metal. Several hands-on reports back this up with strong performance on M1 machines, for example ~56–83 ms/token on 7B models and 63 t/s generation with gemma-3-4b on an M1 MacBook Pro. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the Metal backend (setup, GPU offload configuration), and independent benchmarks that explicitly attribute the speedups to Metal rather than CPU/NEON.
